subject: reference-binomial

created_trees.objective: Combiner la parallélisation OpenMP de T2 avec la réduction de récurrence de T1, en partant du candidat T2 le plus rapide. Préserver les bornes et la convention de terminal de T1, le budget de threads, l’API et l’écriture complète de la sortie. Faire valider puis mesurer le candidat combiné.
created_trees.stop_condition: Ne retenir la combinaison que si l’évaluateur la valide et si sa mesure officielle bat T2 ; sinon garder T2 comme meilleur candidat mesuré. Préserver la confirmation indépendante.
created_trees.subject: Évaluer la combinaison T2 parallèle + T1 à somme pondérée

active_architecture.warning: Model wall times overlap research; do not add them to campaign wall time

children.objective: Explore replacing the triangular backward recurrence with its equivalent binomial-weighted terminal payoff sum. Derive it from the actual loop bounds: there are 63 effective updates, and the 64 terminal values use exponents 2*j-64 for j=0..63. Preserve that endpoint convention and discounting; do not add a j=64 payoff. Validate against the baseline on varied per-element inputs and every available correctness case, including numerical edge cases. Record failures rather than weakening tolerance, and report measured latency.
children.subject: Reduce the backward lattice work with an endpoint-faithful weighted sum

children.objective: Parallelize independent input elements using OpenMP while initially retaining each element's baseline arithmetic and operation order. Honor the run threads argument without exceeding its budget, keep scratch state private, and assess small-input overhead as well as throughput on the official workload. Validate full output overwrite and correctness; report measurements against the serial baseline.
children.subject: Use the supplied CPU thread budget across independent options

children.objective: Keep the existing 64-value terminal array and backward recurrence, but replace per-node powf calls with a geometric power progression (for example, one starting power followed by multiplication by u squared). Preserve the exact j=0..63 terminal indexing and recurrence order. Measure whether the reduction in transcendental calls helps, and validate FP32 error over varied inputs before retaining it.
children.subject: Reduce terminal payoff power-generation cost without changing the recurrence
